entities.summary: Ulrich Kamka Chomche is a Cameroonian professional basketball player who last played for the Toronto Raptors of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with Raptors 905 of the NBA G League. At 6 ft 11 in, he plays the center position.
